The part the die hard fans will probably not see is the humor and that was half the games charm. You're basically in this extremely bleak world with the majority of people only existing in a handful of cities with little in between and the whole plot is pretty brooding. The boon of it all was some pretty great side quest type stuff like getting Aeris' final weapon which is a bitch to do before a certain point. The chocoholic racing, capture, and breeding process. The snowboarding segment and mini game. A portion of the game where you're controlling a submarine which becomes accessible and usable when ever after a point and it's mini game that shows up.

The game had a decent amount of fluff content and bonus content for those that wanted to really persue it.

All in all plot wise I'm not terribly ok with it because it winds up kind of hokey in the end and doesn't really explain shit aside from I can do what I want because I'm determined to regardless if I actually have the skill to do so.

For them to keep it true and update it visually and game play they really have no option other than to break it up. Scale wise the game is pretty massive.

Breaking it up is the least of my concerns. My biggest is what kind of fight mechanics are they going to use and are they going to implement Zack's and Vincent's back stories into it.

If xenoblade chronicles x can fit on one disc then new FF7 should be able to as well. I'm really concerned that the game will be butchered by censorship. I would also like it if they would make those toy soldiers that you collect would actually unlock sephiroth as an optional character.

Expand the gold saucer to include more minigames, maybe some gambling. Not to mention a permant vendor that will trade Gil for GP instead of the creepy dude that appears randomly.
